items.title: Closing the data loop in AI-driven drug discovery
items.summary: Drug discovery is a high-cost, high-risk endeavor that is under growing pressure from a market increasingly defined by first-mover advantage. Since the 1950s, the cost of developing new pharmaceuticals has roughly doubled every nine years—a phenomenon known as Eroom’s Law. items.title: Building the enterprise environment for agentic AI
items.summary: For the enterprise, the promise of agentic AI is much more than just a better chatbot.
